mapper.select:
select `employeeinfo`.*, `employee`.`employee_code` as employeeCode, `employee`.`name` as employeeName, `employee`.`phone` as employeePhone, `employee`.`email` as employeeEmail from `employeeinfo` left join `employee` on `employeeinfo`.`employee_id` = `employee`.id
and `employee`.`employee_code` like concat ('%', #{employeeCode}, '%')
and `employee`.`name` like concat ('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
and `employeeinfo`.`employee_id` = #{employeeId}
